title: Psychedelic Head Garden
description: A surreal scene featuring a glossy blue head sculpture in the center with a zipper across its face, flanked by two potted plants with swirling, colorful growths emerging from them. A large hypnotic spiral vortex swirls in the purple sky above, surrounded by floating circular motifs and glowing orbs against a dark, dreamy landscape.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of a glossy blue head sculpture with a zipper across its closed eyes, placed centrally on a patterned floor. Two terracotta pots with green stems and swirling colorful circular growths and orbs flank the head. A massive hypnotic spiral vortex swirls in the purple and dark blue sky above, with floating symbols and glowing elements. Dreamlike colorful atmosphere with soft blended brushwork.
